S.FORM: == kakaliman: == mangga漫畫 ina X sapisasetset nu kincal , atu milecaday a kungku itawya i amilika kanamuhan , namakay 2000 a mihcaan malingatu mucuduh u mahicaay a icelangay : saicelangay nu kitakit makatapal tu canan a icelang atu niasipan a icelang tucek kitidaan :misumaday tu tademaw a cacudaan patidengay a kuciw sinsi , u cabay ni wan-ce-waang , u cayay katatudung ku udip inayay ku kuku' . u mahicaay a icelangay: idaw ku icelang pakakapah tu duka mihaymaw balaki atu maadih ku ukak nu pukuh , nadikudan sa i ukak pacumudan tu ya-te-man-he-cin , kyu ya ukak sapidakep mala ya-te-man pulung tu ekim a nisangaan 異能: ucek kitidaan : imahini a paculi tu ada mapulung naming tu katuuday , "u siadaay a masakaputay atu X a milepacaway a kincal" a kungku I telay mipili' kuheni a paculi tu ada nu masakaputay itini vs X u mahicaay a icelangay : u tabakiay ku celang nu heni atu icelan tu sapiasip,u icelang nu hung-huwang tucek kitidaan : saicelangay nu kitakit amusumaday a tademaw , i labu nu udipan idaw ku icelang nu hung-huwang , ayda sa mapacekil tu. mangga: yu limecedan henay alan nu kuyu patayni i aydaan atu mapacekilay a masakapahay cin masasuaduh. u mahicaay a icelangay : matineng misumad tu demiad. tucek kitidaan :nu luma' nipalaylay makaala tu malebut a mihcaan ; nayi "u-tu-pang" mala tapang , ayda sa milihida tu cayay katatudung a X miwaitay a masakaputay. u mahicaay a icelangay : yu mitepal tu tademaw sa , mataneng muhelup tu udipi nutaw sisa idaw ku malakuwiytay a icelang. tucek kitidaan :ayda milihida milab utu mapulungay a masakaputay "u cayay katatudung a siadaay a tademaw" . u mahicaay a icelangay : makatesek makaadih tu mukin a udiudipan pasaicelang makaala . mangga: u kakama ni mi-ke , milihida milabu u ci-paw ku mukeliday maluyaluy . u mahicaay a icelangay : anu mahica ku wayway masumad mala aadupan u hekalnida idaw ku mikikaka ku icelang nu udip . kakulian: kanatal nu hitay mamisumaday a mikuwanay nu sakakaay atu pulung nu kanatal a sakakaay tucek kitidaan :mala a uenuenan nu ke-siy , caay kasasukapah aci cacayay nu mata cacay ky kamu masasu ada tu kyu miliyas tu u-tu-pang , milab utu cayay katinengi a mibelihay a tademaw . namakay nuayawan a malingatu tu lim a X malpacaway a kincal a kaput "se-kaw-te-.cin, naayaway a udip, u suleda atademaw atu dungi" alan pataluma' . u mahicaay a icelangay :matineng pala budawan ku udiudipan , idaw ku icelang nu eking . nay tidaay; papululan a sasalamaan a huwang-hu , malabu tu X malepacaway a kincal .
